🎥🎬: X-Men ’97 (2024–Present)

Following the loss of Professor Charles Xavier, the X-Men must continue his dream of peaceful coexistence between humans and mutants while facing a world that remains deeply divided over their existence. Cyclops steps into a greater leadership role as the team struggles with both new responsibilities and old rivalries.

Their future becomes even more complicated when Magneto unexpectedly enters the picture, forcing the X-Men to question whether their longtime enemy has truly changed. Meanwhile, powerful new threats emerge as anti-mutant tensions grow, pushing heroes like Wolverine, Storm, Jean Grey, Rogue, Gambit, and the rest of the team into battles that test them physically and emotionally.

Continuing the story of the beloved 1990s animated series, X-Men ’97 combines classic Marvel animation with mature storytelling, intense action, and the ongoing struggle between acceptance, fear, and mutant survival.
